allowed_inputs: terminal_action_feature_keys outputs that pass the central firewall
exact waypoint/fence success labels for training and grading
fixed-seed black uniform legal replies for rollout evaluation
baselines: sealed flat learned Stage A baseline from Phase 2.9a
causal ablation with discovered structure removed
forbidden: hidden terminal aliases and old terminal-only aliases
hand-authored approach resolver as candidate generator
grown_structures: primitive atom TERMINALs keyed by sealed terminal/action atoms
finite quorum SCRIPTs over those atoms with k=n confirmation
a root dispatcher that scores moves by confirmed learned atoms/quorums
meaning_of_autonomous_discovery: The probe enumerates legal actions from frozen approach-rung starts, observes only sealed terminal/action keys, mines atomic terminals and finite k-of-n quorum SCRIPTs from outcome-labeled action evidence, and uses those grown structures for move selection. The hand approach skill is used only as an outcome labeler/ceiling, never as a candidate generator or learner-visible feature source.
success_definition: Useful if discovered topology beats fallback/random, leaks zero keys, and ablation reduces heldout conversion. Competitive if it reaches the sealed flat learned baseline band.
